findings.reason: the plan must name the single owner of the operator-hooks carry, or state that clive's expansion-time read supersedes reckon's harness-home settings for profiled workers, so the two sources cannot drift.
findings.text: clive's expansion re-implements the operator-hooks carry that reckon's fence already owns in reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reading `$HOME/.claude/settings.json` and merging `hooks` into the explicit `--settings`, and the plan does not say which owner wins when both apply under a fence (reckon's carried settings are inert under the chosen `--setting-sources ''`)

findings.reason: with cli_options 0 and refusal_families 0 the section must account for the interface surface it adds in its own text, by naming what it retires or why nothing can be.
findings.text: the section adds `--worker-profile` (clive.py:129), a named refusal family (clive.py:783,796,819,829) and a receipt schema plus the `CLIVE_PROFILE_RECEIPT` variable (clive.py:897-938) without retiring or merging any interface

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — a single flag (`--worker-profile PATH`) hides profile validation, hook-aware settings assembly, prompt composition and the receipt, so the interface is far smaller than the behaviour behind it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the operator-hooks carry now has two owners: clive's expansion reads `~/.claude/settings.json` and merges its hooks (imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:773,843,866), while reckon's worker fence already carries the operator `settings.json` (filtered to hooks) into the fenced harness home (reckon/crew/dispatch.py).
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 adds a CLI option, a named refusal family and a receipt schema without naming what it retires or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design extends clive's existing settings/system-prompt route (imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:988-990) and assigns digest generation to reckon, where reckon/crew/worker_digest.py already owns it; it adds no parallel digest generator or MCP reader.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the expansion parameterises clive's existing `--settings`/`--append-system-prompt` route rather than wrapping a distinct mechanism, and the plan states why clive (not reckon) owns the flag expansion.
